text:
ella: heads up — after the int8->int4 quant bridge test we started seeing embed recall drop for near-duplicate detection in the sampling pipeline.

pranav: noticed this too. recall@1 for anchors fell from 0.92 -> 0.78 on canary. which model/quant config?

ella: qbridge q6b-int4-fast, dropping kernel pack that we used in the perf path. looks like cosine distances shifted slightly, enough to break fingerprint clustering.

lucy: that would explain dedupe scatter. I saw a flood of near-duplicates make it into the golden candidate pool this morning. golden size +30%.

omar: any chance this is tokenizer change or just numeric drift? I ran a spot compare and token counts are identical.

pranav: replicated the embed delta on my workstation. small vector offsets concentrated in stopword-heavy long prompts. suspect quantization truncation on the tail dims.

label-ops: we're getting noisy batches — annotator throughput down 15% because many duplicate-like items still get labelled. can you patch the manifest?

ella: mitigation idea: re-run embedding generation for the last 12h with the int8 fallback for dedupe-only pass, keep int4 for generation. cheap re-embed window instead of full rehash.

ingest-bot: alert: 237 candidate anchors flagged as high-similarity that passed dedupe (last 6h)

omar: script I used to re-embed the window:
```
./tools/regen_embeds.sh --seedbank canary --since 1754280000 --model q6b-int8-fallback --out tmp/embeds_redux.npy
python tools/merge_candidate_pool.py --embeds tmp/embeds_redux.npy --manifest canary_candidates.json --mode replace
```

dry-run was green.

pranav: +1 to that plan. also add a quick eval: compute recall on golden anchors pre/post and stop if recall delta > 0.02.

ella: agreed. I'll run the re-embed and pull a 200-sample golden rescore. pinging @label-ops to hold on new batches until we complete.

label-ops: ack — pausing auto assignment to the canary queue, will hold live campaigns for 30m.

lucy: followup: we should add a gating in quant bringup: run embed-consistency check vs control int8 for top-1/5 recall on a fixed anchor set. add to onboarding checklist.

omar: created INF-3701: quant-embed-consistency-gate and INF-3702: quick-reembed-fallback-job.

ella: update: re-embed applied for window, candidate pool replaced, golden rescore 200 samples = 189/200 agreement (baseline 192/200). improvement vs int4-only that triggered the issue.

pranav: nice. re-enable assignment when label-ops says ready. also let's log embedding checksum shape in the ingest trace — small diffs caused a cascade.

label-ops: unpause approved. resuming assignments. thanks for the quick turn. :party_parrot:

ella: retrospective action items: 1) add embed-gate to qbringup playbook 2) add uint8 fallback for dedupe pass 3) run a focused longprompt regression in next canary. I'll file followups.

ingest-bot: ticket created: INF-3701, INF-3702, INF-3703

ella: closing thread — will post the run artifacts and eval plots in the canary run board.
